capabilities: Copy a shareable obsid.net link for the current note to the clipboard
Open the current note through the obsid.net redirect
Trigger both actions from the command palette
Configure what the ribbon icon does (copy vs. open)
disambiguation: Not a Microsoft or Office integration; the name refers to using a standard HTTPS link instead of a custom URI scheme.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; all link-conversion and redirect logic lives in the separate obsid.net project by Joost de Valk.
problem: Chat apps, emails, and other tools strip custom URI schemes, so obsidian:// deep links are not clickable outside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a thin Obsidian wrapper around obsid.net

summary: Link utility that copies or opens a shareable obsid.net HTTPS URL wrapping Obsidian's obsidian:// deep link for the current note.
